units.rawText: What happened in the past... Umm... It feels like it's been a long time.

units.rawText: I still remember—the moment we met was at the edge of the Oasis. I was under attack by the Sanctifiers, my body severely damaged. My arms, legs, eyes... even my neural cloud was damaged. Even when familiar faces showed up, my first instinct upon seeing weapons was to run.

units.rawText: But just as I was about to run, Professor, you dashed toward me and hugged me. Then, you said the kindest words I've ever heard... "Don't worry, you can stay by my side."

units.rawText: Whilst in your arms, I slowly calmed down and felt safe for the first time. You took me back with the Exiles, and that was how we first met in the Cloud. Though I'm not sure if my words can be helpful to you.
